question: is useful out-of-sample signal for realized volatility h6 detectable from the available causal inputs before compression, or is predictability beyond persistence not demonstrated on the available data?

field_map_from_n0.statistical_unit: N0 said '(fold x arm)'; N1.1.1 corrects it: the unit is the CAUSAL SCORE WINDOW; arms are paired treatments within each unit
field_map_from_n0.folds: N0 declared two folds A/B; N1.1.2 replaces them with FOUR non-overlapping causal score windows; N0's fold B score [65%,75%) partially overlapped the consumed origin-0 monitor [69.7%,85%) — disclosed; N1 windows all end strictly BEFORE 69.7% (stricter than the order's 85% boundary, because screen v2 consumed BOTH monitor regions)
field_map_from_n0.arms: N0's arm '1_persistence' was a FITTED ridge on the trailing predictor; N1.1.5 splits it honestly into literal_persistence (no fitted coefficient) and calibrated_ar1 (the fitted one-variable autoregression); N0 arms 2 and 3 unchanged in substance; N0 arms 4 and 5 remain frozen historical context, never pooled (N1.1.7)
field_map_from_n0.embargo: N0 declared purge_bars=12 without derivation; N1.1.4 derives the embargo in SAMPLED-ROW units: ceil(target_horizon 6 bars / sampling stride 4 bars) = 2 rows, applied between calibration and score AND between consecutive score windows
field_map_from_n0.multiplicity: unchanged: Holm over the two direct arms; N1.1.3 adds: with fewer than four valid units the only legal inferential verdict is INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_UNITS
field_map_from_n0.budget_seeds_device: unchanged from N0: <=5000 updates per temporal (window, seed) unit; frozen seeds 101/202/303/404; CUDA for the temporal arm per the measured benchmark; CPU for persistence/ar1/linear

statistical_unit: the causal score window; four units; arms are paired treatments within each unit; every score observation belongs to exactly one unit

role_geometry.derivation: n = number of sampled rows in the immutable npz; origin0_limit = floor(0.85*n); consumed_frontier = floor(origin0_limit*0.82) — the START of screen v2's origin-0 monitor (both consumed monitor regions [frontier, n) are excluded entirely); embargo_rows = ceil(6/4) = 2; cal_len = floor(0.08*n); L = floor((frontier - floor(0.30*n) - 3*embargo_rows)/4)
role_geometry.windows: for k = 4..1: score_k = [e_k - L, e_k) with e_4 = frontier and e_{k-1} = start_k - embargo_rows; cal_k = [start_k - cal_len - embargo_rows, start_k - embargo_rows); fit_k = [0, start_k - cal_len - embargo_rows)
role_geometry.properties: training expands forward; every calibration window precedes its score window with the derived embargo; score windows are pairwise disjoint with embargo gaps so no label crosses a score boundary; exact source-index ranges are persisted per unit in the ledger
role_geometry.walk_forward_disclosure: later windows' fit/cal ranges include earlier windows' score rows — inherent to expanding-window designs; each unit's own score rows are untouched by its own fit/cal; the paired estimator treats windows as the units

insufficient_units_rule: if fewer than four valid score windows materialize from the real n, execute the mechanics and return INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_UNITS; no Holm-adjusted inference is claimed from fewer than four units

arms.literal_persistence: prediction = the trailing realized volatility value itself; NO fitted coefficient; the materiality baseline
arms.calibrated_ar1: one-variable ridge autoregression target ~ trailing, fitted on the fit role with calibration-selected lambda; reported SEPARATELY as a stronger baseline, never as a replacement for literal persistence
arms.direct_linear: ridge on the flattened causal feature window (all 83 columns x 64 rows), fitted on fit, lambda selected on calibration
arms.direct_temporal: gru_branch over all 83 features + linear head, end to end, <=5000 Adam updates, checkpoint selection on calibration only; four frozen seeds per window
arms.frozen_best_branch: HISTORICAL CONTEXT ONLY from the accepted screen-v2 report (measured on consumed roles); never pooled with N1 units, never a paired observation

identical_consumption: direct_linear and direct_temporal consume exactly the same immutable npz (windows, target, trailing), the same score units and the same roles; no fold-level target or feature scaling exists (the causal rolling normalization is row-local and upstream); the npz digest binds this in the ledger and is re-verified at claim time

estimator_and_decision.per_window_skill: R2 over the window's score rows (1 - SSE/SST vs the window mean)
estimator_and_decision.per_window_temporal_score: the mean of the four seed R2 values; all four seeds are REQUIRED for the unit to count; seed dispersion reported
estimator_and_decision.paired_difference: d_k = R2_arm(k) - R2_literal_persistence(k) over the four windows
estimator_and_decision.interval: two-sided t-based 95% CI on mean(d), df=3
estimator_and_decision.advance_rule: an arm ADVANCES iff (a) R2_arm(k) > 0 on ALL four windows, (b) mean(d) >= 0.02, (c) CI low > 0, and (d) Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 across the two direct arms
estimator_and_decision.missing_unit_rule: any FAILED, TIMED_OUT or missing unit, or any temporal unit without all four seeds, is preserved in the verdict and forces INCONCLUSIVE with the named cause

decision_table.PREDICTABILITY_NOT_DEMONSTRATED: neither direct arm advances and no direct arm has all-window-positive skill
decision_table.REPRESENTATION_BOTTLENECK_DEMONSTRATED: at least one direct arm ADVANCES (frozen branch evidence is negative as a fixed historical fact)
decision_table.FUSION_BOTTLENECK_DEMONSTRATED: frozen branch evidence advances and frozen fusion does not (historically unreachable; kept for completeness)
decision_table.INCONCLUSIVE_DISCORDANT: no arm advances but at least one direct arm shows all-window-positive skill without margin or significance

execution.devices: persistence/ar1/linear on CPU; temporal on ONE explicitly bound CUDA device after device + entry-point + immutable-input preflights; if no reviewed CUDA slot is free the temporal units stay PENDING with a typed reason (no silent CPU fallback)
execution.budget: <=5000 optimizer updates per temporal (window, seed) unit; 16 temporal units + 12 CPU units = 28 units
execution.retry: no automatic retry after a terminal scientific result (FAILED is terminal); infrastructure interruptions (INTERRUPTED/TIMED_OUT) resume only through the same ledgered identity
execution.stop_file: run_root/STOP — the supervisor terminates and reaps workers before marking interrupted
execution.no_promotion: no checkpoint from this diagnostic is promotable
